score.threshold: Upstream ENCODE-rE2G thresholded element-gene links use model-specific score cutoffs calibrated to 70% recall. The inspected filtering code retains score >= the model threshold. Verified model thresholds: dhs_megamap 0.201, dhs_h3k27ac_megamap 0.217, dhs_intact_hic 0.243, dhs_h3k27ac_intact_hic 0.298, atac_megamap 0.179, atac_h3k27ac_megamap 0.203, atac_intact_hic 0.232, atac_h3k27ac_intact_hic 0.259, and extended 0.336. ENCFF003BKC is explicitly a thresholded element-gene file; match each input file to its model/version before choosing a cutoff. See ../threshold-evidence.md for the inspected code revision and remaining file-to-model verification.
